facts.fact: RISA's 2024 Digital Adoption Implementation Guidelines require all government institutions to have disaster recovery plans and off-site backups, refer to RISA's published Business Continuity Management guidelines, and require critical systems hosted in the National Data Centre to subscribe to a hosting plan with daily backups and disaster recovery services; main site and backup site places not stated; the document gives only its copyright year 2024.

note: Guideline text states DR and off-site backup requirements and a DR service in the National Data Centre hosting plan; no backup site in service, place, test or Tier is named.
